evals.prompt: Find edge cases for GET /api/v1/events/{id} in the event-catalog-service. The endpoint fetches an event by its UUID. Read the controller, service, entity, and repository files to find missing edge cases. Generate JUnit 5 test code for each uncovered scenario.
evals.expected_output: An edge case report listing missing scenarios for the GET by ID endpoint, with JUnit 5 test code for each missing scenario. Should include at least: UUID format validation, soft-delete handling (410 Gone), resource not found (404), and any other uncovered edge cases.
expectations: The report identifies at least 3 missing edge cases for the GET endpoint
The report includes 'UUID format validation' as an edge case
The report checks whether soft-deleted resources return 404/410
Generated tests use MockMvc or RestTestClient (not TestRestTemplate)
Generated tests use @MockitoBean (not @MockBean)
Generated tests include @DisplayName annotations
Generated tests verify HTTP status codes with andExpect(status().isXxx())
The report checks whether integration tests exist for this endpoint with Testcontainers
The report checks whether lazy loading issues exist (entity returned directly with lazy relationships)

evals.prompt: Find edge cases for POST /api/v1/events in the event-catalog-service. The endpoint creates a new event. Read the controller, service, entity, DTO, and repository files to find missing edge cases. Generate JUnit 5 test code for each uncovered scenario.
evals.expected_output: An edge case report listing missing scenarios for the POST create endpoint, with JUnit 5 test code for each missing scenario. Should include at least: missing @Valid on request body, missing field-level validation constraints, missing X-User-Id header, BOLA (object-level authorization), concurrency (duplicate creation), and any other uncovered edge cases.
expectations: The report identifies at least 4 missing edge cases for the POST endpoint
The report checks whether @Valid is present on the request body parameter
The report checks for missing @NotBlank/@Size annotations on DTO fields
The report checks whether X-User-Id header is required
The report checks for BOLA vulnerabilities (ownership verification)
Generated tests use @MockitoBean (not @MockBean)
Generated tests verify 400 Bad Request for invalid input
Generated tests verify 401/403 for missing/wrong authorization
The report checks whether @Transactional + Kafka/event publish has rollback issues
The report checks for OSIV (open-in-view) configuration

evals.prompt: Find edge cases for GET /api/v1/events in the event-catalog-service. This endpoint lists events with pagination support (page, size, sort parameters). Read the controller, service, entity, and repository files to find missing edge cases. Generate JUnit 5 test code for each uncovered scenario.
evals.expected_output: An edge case report listing missing scenarios for the paginated list endpoint, with JUnit 5 test code for each missing scenario. Should include at least: maximum page size validation, negative page handling, sort field SQL injection, soft-delete filtering in paginated results, missing has_more flag, and any other uncovered edge cases.
expectations: The report identifies at least 3 missing edge cases for the paginated endpoint
The report checks for a maximum page size cap (e.g. @Max)
The report checks whether negative page/size values are rejected
The report checks whether soft-deleted records are excluded from results
The report checks whether sort parameters allow SQL injection
Generated tests verify 400 for size=0 or size exceeding max
Generated tests verify has_more or equivalent pagination metadata
The report checks whether an integration test exists with Testcontainers for pagination
The report checks whether soft-delete is verified in integration tests (not just repository tests)
